name: index-list
description: Select objects whose index (offset) is in the list; the numbers need not be sequential.
notes: Live-checked on 3DEC 9.8.54 (2026-10-29): the numbers are the FISH block.index offsets (string(block.index(block.find(1))) gave 2 and 670 for two blocks), not Python Block.index(), which returned 1 and 2. 'index-list 670' selected block 2; 'index-list 0' fails with 'Unused extra parameter'.
